title: Okanagan Valley Discovery Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Just over an hour south of Kelowna - Explore a truly fascinating natural area and special place in British Columbia and Canada. 

Vaseux Lake has one of the highest species diversity in Canada! We visit several unusual and rare habitats in the area including White Lake Grasslands Protected Area. We access sites either by boardwalk, viewing tower, or trail. 

This hike is rated as easy and not physically demanding.
